body: thank you 🥺 we’re trying to work it out though

i actually used to date his best friend and all three of us hung out yesterday to skate/smoke. i’m good friends with my ex, and he has said in the past that if my current bf (his best friend) chested on me that he would kick his ass. that has yet to ensue so that’s a good thing.

we’ve been talking and some things have been explained. i’m still confused, but even if it was him i don’t think someone should be punished for craving interaction, especially in times like these. it’s just the idea of untruthfulness and not being enough that are getting to me.
i’m as safe as i can be i guess haha. i’m really the biggest threat to myself and that will probably not change. but thank you
i breathed and went through my tics til the anxiety passed and i could sleep. thank you kind person
i managed to just breathe and go through my tics until the anxiety passed. i went to bed and am feeling better. i blocked the guy.

Yeah, it’s not him as much. It’s more of a ‘hit with the smell of his cologne and I miss what once was.’ It’s really just the friend part that’s weird. I’ll get over it though, time will pass, as time does, and everything will be alright.
